positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Refactor playback architecture on KaiOS and reduce the power consumption about 25%.
2. Design and implement SoundTrigger WebAPI
3. Integrate 3rd party building system to KaiOS internal environment and reduce the building time about 50%.
4. Coordinate the engineering resources among Taiepi, Shanghai, and Xi'an.
5. Work closely with chipset vendor to solve issues.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
1. Build up media team
2. Mentor and lead Taipei and Beijing teams
3. Integrate camera module on Android M to H5OS

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
1. Mentor and lead the media team with 8 talented engineers
2. Coordinate with other engineering teams, QA, project teams and partners.
3. Hire the top engineers  and help them on career development.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
1. Bring up WebRTC on Firefox OS.
2. WebRTC performance tuning on devices.
3. Implement Time and FM radio API on Firefox OS.
4. Partner training

positions.title: supervisor
positions.description:
1. Mentor and lead the SDK team with 6 talented software engineers.
2. Coordinate with other teams, including firmware, QA, PM, sales, and FAE team.
3. Optimizing the SDK performance, reduce about 40% of CPU usage.
4. Maintain streaming, codec, and other camera control modules.
5. Customer supporting and FAE training.
